label: D2 rare a1->S2 transition, low value (late episode)
explanation: Fires only at D2, only when the state input is S2, and 96% of activation mass falls on rare transitions after choosing a1 (a1 -> S2). It is silent at D1 and GO, on S1, and nearly silent on common a2 -> S2 (4% of mass). Within a1 -> S2 it fires on about 24% of steps. It is gated by low model value: with value < 7.13 dev F1 is 0.69 (P 0.59, R 0.83, mass recall 0.92); value >= 7.54 never fires. It also rises steeply with episode time: it never fires before trial 40, and the rate climbs to 3.7% in trials 90-99 (ep_trial >= 50 gives F1 0.61). This late-episode drift probably explains the low value. Activation is more common when the previous trial was unrewarded. It is more common when S1 is the good state (so the rare transition reached the bad state), but adding good != 2 did not help. All variables are observable at D2, so uses_future is false. The value threshold is the model internal state, so this is partly circular. Pure input description: (phase==D2)&(state==2)&(action==1), R 0.94 and mass 0.96 but P 0.24.
